value.signature: fn content_matches_supplied_commitment (id : & ActId , proposal : & ProposalCommitment , recorded : & ContentCommitment , host_content_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , pair : & ContentPair ,) -> Result < () , ProfileError >

review.body: { if recorded . recipe != CONTENT_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } let content = content_pre_digest (id , pair) ? ; if content_commitment (id , proposal , host_content_blinding_value , & content) ? != * recorded { return Err (ProfileError :: Mismatch) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both author blinding values and host blinding values, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
